component.name: Workspace Hub
component.summary: Your Linux workday, in one familiar place

description.p: Workspace Hub provides a calm GNOME-native starting point for desktop applications, web apps, files, shared locations, workspace status and support.

Create independent workspaces, organise items in section tabs, switch between workspaces, copy or move configured items, and safely reuse a complete workspace setup without requiring an account or server.
Workspace profiles stay local and can be imported or exported as portable JSON files.

Initial public beta with multi-workspace management, context-aware workspace reset, repeatable example-workspace creation, workspace-specific history restore, section tabs, local application discovery, portable profiles, live item copy and move actions, guarded full-workspace content replacement, privacy-conscious diagnostics, and fail-closed persistence recovery.
